english: A salmon shark! Did you see it cruising just under the surface? I want every detail.

english: A dusky shark — Endangered, magnificent, and in no hurry at all. What did you see?
quebec_french: Un requin sombre! En danger, magnifique et jamais pressé. Qu'est-ce que tu as observé?

quebec_french: Des bordures blanches sur toutes les nageoires! Tu as marqué un requin à pointes argentées. Regarde ces extrémités!

english: A silvertip! Were those fin margins as white as they say? Bold shark, bold tag — I need the full story!
quebec_french: Un requin à pointes argentées! Ses nageoires étaient aussi blanches aux extrémités qu'on le dit? Raconte-moi tout!

quebec_french: Un requin tisserand! Tu l'as vu bondir? La balise est fixée et c'est lui, le spécialiste des vrilles!

english: A spinner! Did you see the breach? The spin, the splash — I need the whole scene!
quebec_french: Un requin tisserand! Il a bondi? Il a tourné, éclaboussé? Je veux toute la scène!

english: You found the carpet shark! A spotted wobbegong, tagged without stepping on it. Excellent.
quebec_french: Tu as trouvé le requin-tapis tacheté! Marqué sans lui marcher dessus. Excellent.

english: A wobbegong! Did you spot the beard before you saw the shark? Details, cousin, details!
quebec_french: Un requin-tapis tacheté! Tu as remarqué sa barbe avant de voir le requin? Les détails, cousin!

english: Leopard shark tagged! Those saddles are unmistakable — beautiful animal.
quebec_french: Requin-léopard marqué! Ses motifs en selle sont impossibles à confondre. Quel bel animal.

english: A leopard shark! Those saddles — did you get a good look at the pattern? Tell me all about it!
quebec_french: Un requin-léopard! Tu as bien vu le motif sur son dos? Raconte-moi tout!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: Horn shark tagged! Spines, crushing teeth, and the weirdest eggs in the sea. What a shark.
quebec_french: Requin-corne marqué! Épines, dents broyeuses et œufs parmi les plus étranges de la mer. Quel requin.

english: A horn shark! The little tank with the venomous spines! How close did you get?
quebec_french: Un requin-corne! Le petit blindé aux épines venimeuses! Tu étais proche comment?
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: Port Jackson tagged! Look at that brow ridge — the most judgmental shark in Australia, and we love it.
quebec_french: Requin de Port-Jackson marqué! Regarde ses grosses arcades sourcilières. Le requin le plus sévère d'Australie. On l'adore.

english: A Port Jackson! Did it give you the unimpressed look? I need every detail!
quebec_french: Un requin de Port-Jackson! Il t'a lancé son regard blasé? Je veux tous les détails!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: AN — an angelshark! Critically Endangered, and you just tagged one! This data goes straight into the real conservation picture!
quebec_french: UN... un ange de mer! En danger critique, et tu viens d'en marquer un! Ces données peuvent aider à mieux comprendre où l'espèce survit!

english: An angelshark! You found one! Was it buried? Did you see the strike? Walk me through it!
quebec_french: Un ange de mer! Tu en as trouvé un! Il était enfoui? Tu as vu son attaque? Raconte-moi tout!

english: MM — a MEGAMOUTH! One of the rarest sharks on Earth, and it's wearing your tag! Every megamouth sighting is a science event!
quebec_french: UN REQUIN GRANDE-GUEULE! Une rencontre rarissime, et tu lui as posé une balise! Chaque observation de cette espèce est un événement pour la science!

english: A megamouth! You actually tagged a megamouth! How big was that mouth? I need the whole story!
quebec_french: Un requin grande-gueule! Tu as vraiment marqué un requin grande-gueule! Sa bouche était énorme comment? Je veux toute l'histoire!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: SA — a sawshark! Chainsaw rostrum, tagged and tracked! One of the coolest faces in the ocean, honestly!
quebec_french: UN REQUIN-SCIE! Un rostre en forme de scie, une balise, et un des museaux les plus incroyables de l'océan!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A sawshark! The saw, the whiskers — did you see it slash? Don't skip a thing!
quebec_french: Un requin-scie à long nez! La scie, les moustaches... tu l'as vu frapper? Ne saute rien!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: GL — a Greenland shark! Possibly centuries old, and YOU tagged it! This data could outlive both of us, literally!
quebec_french: UN REQUIN DU GROENLAND! Il a peut-être plusieurs siècles, et TU viens de le marquer! Ces données pourraient être utiles longtemps, très longtemps.
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A Greenland shark! The deep's slowest, oldest predator! How slow was it really? Give me the whole story!
quebec_french: Un requin du Groenland! Le vieux prédateur des profondeurs! Il était vraiment si lent? Raconte-moi tout!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: CC — a cookiecutter! The tiniest, weirdest shark in the book, and you actually caught one alive! That's nearly unheard of!
quebec_french: UN SQUALELET FÉROCE! Un des requins les plus petits et les plus étranges du carnet, observé vivant! C'est tellement rare!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A cookiecutter! Sixty centimetres of pure audacity! Did you see the glow? I need details!
quebec_french: Un squalelet féroce! Soixante centimètres d'audace pure! Tu as vu sa lumière? Je veux les détails!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: SX — a bluntnose sixgill! An ancient deep-water giant, and you pulled it up into the light of science!
quebec_french: UN REQUIN GRISET! Un géant des profondeurs issu d'une lignée ancienne, et tu viens de le ramener dans nos notes de recherche!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A sixgill! Six gills on an ancient line — did you count them? What was it like down there?
quebec_french: Un requin griset! Six fentes branchiales sur une vieille lignée! Tu les as comptées? C'était comment là-dessous?
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: YES! Got the little lantern! Look at that belly glow — counter-illumination in action. Textbook velvet-belly!
quebec_french: OUI! Le petit requin lumineux! Regarde ce ventre qui brille : de la contre-illumination en action. Un sagre commun comme dans les livres!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A velvet-belly lanternshark! Did you see it glow? The deep's little lantern — tell me all about it!
quebec_french: Un sagre commun! Tu as vu sa lumière? La petite lanterne des profondeurs. Raconte-moi!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: IT'S SO SMALL! That's a full-grown dwarf lanternshark — one of the tiniest sharks on the planet. Incredible!
quebec_french: IL EST TELLEMENT PETIT! C'est un requin-lanterne nain adulte, un des plus petits requins du monde. Incroyable!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A dwarf lanternshark! The tiniest shark in the book! Was it really that small? I need every detail!
quebec_french: Un requin-lanterne nain! Le plus petit du carnet! Il était vraiment si minuscule? Je veux tout savoir!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: KITEFIN! That's a heavyweight of the deep — look at those eyes. Gorgeous, ancient, and still here. What a shark!
quebec_french: UN SQUALE LICHE! Un poids lourd des profondeurs. Regarde ses yeux! Magnifique, ancien, toujours là. Quel requin!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A kitefin! Those huge green eyes in the dark! What was it like? Don't leave anything out!
quebec_french: Un squale liche! Ces grands yeux verts dans le noir! C'était comment? Ne laisse rien de côté!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: SLEEPER! Four metres of slow-motion majesty, right on the line. Look at that barrel body — the ocean's most patient predator!
quebec_french: UN REQUIN DORMEUR! Quatre mètres de majesté au ralenti. Regarde ce corps massif : un des chasseurs les plus patients de l'océan!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A Pacific sleeper! The four-metre shadow! Was it as slow as they say? I want the whole story!
quebec_french: Un requin dormeur du Pacifique! L'ombre de quatre mètres! Il avançait aussi lentement qu'on le dit? Raconte!
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

quebec_french: Un aiguillat! Un petit client épineux pour le journal. Regarde ses dorsales : on admire, mais on ne touche pas.
notes: Sarah's voice; Roman to review scientific names.

english: A spiny dogfish! Did you dodge the spines? Tell me about this one!
quebec_french: Un aiguillat commun! Tu as évité les épines? Raconte-moi cette rencontre!

english: Catshark! Look at those spots — the classic little European night shark. Gentle, gorgeous, and officially tagged!
quebec_french: Une petite roussette! Regarde ces taches : le petit requin nocturne classique des eaux européennes. Doux, magnifique et maintenant marqué!

english: A small-spotted catshark! The Cornwall night shift delivers! Spots and all — give me every detail!
